forms.label: Coffee liqueur
forms.sourceNote: Alcoholic beverage, liqueur, coffee, 53 proof. Public domain. USDA's own proof label (53, i.e. 26.5% ABV) does not match the strength its measured alcohol-and-density figures resolve to; the 32.4% here is computed from those measured figures rather than the printed proof, per this site's own convention of deriving ABV from mass and density. Generic record; commercial coffee liqueurs vary in both strength and sweetness by brand.
